== Summary ==
Lossless page extract from the complete official Set 8 PDF preserved by the Internet Archive [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005192157id_/https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-8.pdf at 2021-10-05T19:21:57Z]. Extract page1 is original page1 (cover/header); extract page2 is original page5 (the three Light character slips). Text, vector icons and embedded source images are preserved without rasterization or lossy image recompression. The full original has eight readable pages,91,586,923bytes and SHA-256 <code>7c9bcdab4cba33e1af1225c88cd3b0aa6e73839dd3e01658d33369b9f7391cde</code>; it exceeds the Wiki upload size limit and remains unchanged in the source archive. Exact first publication day unknown. Extract SHA-256 <code>5e91c255f40b580f5382b71d4b89c965ff066ed07a8f1898a9e3baba6d0d3e82</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd.; published by the Players Committee.
